title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Awaiting your orders, Doctor.

title: Talk 1
original: The two seniors from the BPRS squad are here too? In that case... Could you assign me to their squards in future missions, Doctor?

title: Talk 2
original: Huff... huff... three more sets of physical training and I'll be half-done for today. Doctor... please... fetch my water bottle for me...

title: Talk 3
original: You want to know about my hometown? My hometown… it's a cruel wilderness. Even survival itself is a difficult feat there. Compared to that, Rhodes Island is like heaven.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I've become stronger than when I was an intern for Blacksteel.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: The 22nd rule of Blacksteel: 'Anyone who loses her weapon no longer belongs here.' That's why I always bring my hellebarde with me wherever I go. The rule doesn't apply to everyday situations, you say? But... if I remember correctly... wait, let me check. 'This rule only applies to contracted Operators and new recruits under training.' What?... Ms. Franka didn't tell me about this part...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Instructor Dobermann's really got a heart of stone! Why choose me other than anyone elase to deal with all those live Originium slugs? I... I just can't!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: I think I know now why Franka and Liskarm decided to stay at Rhodes Island. Compared to Blacksteel, this is a place we can call home. There's lots of fun things to do here besides the missions...

title: Idle
original: Shh, the Doctor's having a rest now. Keep your volume down, would you?

title: Onboard
original: I'm Vanilla, trainee Operator from Blacksteel. Looking forward to learning from you, Doctor.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: It's time to organize my notes. I need to digest what I've just learned.

title: Promotion 1
original: A promotion medal? For me? My-my sincerest gratitude!

title: Added to Squad
original: I'm here to help everyone!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Me, the leader? Are you sure about that?

title: Depart
original: I'll work even harder.

title: Begin Operation
original: I will not bring shame to Blacksteel!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Hmm?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Your words are my command.

title: Deployment 1
original: Okay!

title: Deployment 2
original: Understood.

title: In Battle 1
original: You shall not pass!

title: In Battle 2
original: This hellebarde isn't just for show!

title: In Battle 3
original: Battles aren't always won by the most experienced!

title: In Battle 4
original: Take that!

title: 4-star Result
original: Whew, perfect victory!

title: 3-star Result
original: A very successful operation.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: If we worked a bit harder, we could have done better.

title: Operation Failure
original: I... I'm still not strong enough...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: At your service.

title: Tap
original: Huh?

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor, would you like to dine with me tonight?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year! There's so much good food, plus the party tonight; this is bliss... Back home, our evening supper depended on how much we could catch that day. So we'd be out hunting before sunrise, just to celebrate the New Year. It really wore you out...

title: Greeting
original: Morning, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, I heard it was your birthday. I have some beast jerky from home, please, help yourself to some if you don't mind. The people back home loved it, which is what made them all so strong! Happy birthday, and I wish you another year of good health!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: It's been a while since I came to Rhodes Island, and I'm so grateful to everyone for helping me get settled in with life here. I don't freak out whenever an automatic door opens anymo—ah! Doctor, I think a burdenbeast-looking robot just passed by...
